parameters.negative_prompt: news broadcast, stock footage, advertisement, 3d animation, computer graphics, cartoon, watermark, logo, text, on screen text, subtitles, titles, signature, slow motion, dramatic reaction, handshake, contract signing, celebration, distorted face, distorted hands, extra fingers

response.prompt: Eight-second, 16:9, photorealistic live-action documentary shot. Interior of a lived-in small industrial service-business office connected to a working shop. A competent woman owner in her late fifties sits at the left side of a worn wooden worktable across from a thoughtful male buyer in his early forties at the right. The owner has natural silver-streaked brown hair loosely tied back and wears a plain deep mineral-teal work shirt. The buyer wears a plain charcoal overshirt and has a small unmarked notebook in front of him. Begin in a balanced medium-wide two-shot from just inside the workshop doorway and make one restrained, steady, slow dolly toward the table on a 35mm lens. Soft late-afternoon window light, warm ledger-paper neutrals, deep mineral teal, subtle rust accents, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. Both remain silent: natural breathing and blinking; the owner calmly waits while the buyer glances once from her to his blank notebook and gives a very small listening nod. No dialogue and no visible lip movement. Keep faces, eyes, hands, clothing, furniture, windows, and room geometry stable and realistic. End with the horizontal table edge clearly visible across the lower third. No logos, readable documents, contract, sale, price, handshake, agreement, celebration, confusion, dramatic reaction, or camera-facing performance. Quiet observational documentary film, not an advertisement.
